description: statusOf(machine, now) — a machine's displayed status decays to 'stale' once its latest report is more than staleAfterMs old. The comparison is strictly greater-than, so a report exactly staleAfterMs old is NOT yet stale.

cases.description: Report is 1ms under 18h old: still shows its reported status ('down'), not stale.
Report is exactly 18h old. The threshold side that wins: still fresh (statusOf uses '> staleAfterMs', not '>='), so it shows the reported status ('full'), not stale.
Report is 1ms over 18h old: decays to stale.
A machine with an empty reports array has no status to show, so it is stale by default.
A report filed at the current instant shows its own status verbatim: ok.
A report filed at the current instant shows its own status verbatim: full.
A report filed at the current instant shows its own status verbatim: down.
statusOf looks only at the last element of reports, regardless of what came before.
